subject: spanish
title: Condicional e Hipotesis
welcome_lead: The conditional expresses hypothesis and politeness. Si clauses build counterfactual scenarios.
final_note: What if? — en espanol es el condicional.

concepts.def: If clause + imperfect subjunctive for hypothesis.

walkthroughs.body_html: Si tuviera tiempo, viajaria (imperfect subjunctive + conditional). Past: Si hubiera sabido, habria venido.
